mapper.sql: a.*, (select count(*) from demo_tree_table s WHERE s.parent_id=a.id) as hasChildren
mapper.update: update demo_tree_table set ancestors= CONCAT(#{newParentIds},substring(ancestors, length(#{oldParentIds})+1,length(ancestors)+1)) where ancestors like concat(#{oldParentIds}, '%')
mapper.delete: delete from demo_tree_table where ancestors like concat(#{parentIds}, '%')
